description: VSCode Python IntelliSense (autocomplete, go-to-definition, import resolution) is completely broken. The workspace at /home/ga/workspace/ml_project contains Python files with imports like 'import numpy as np' and 'import pandas as pd' that show red error underlines, and autocomplete/go-to-definition do not work. However, a Python virtual environment exists at /home/ga/workspace/ml_project/venv/ with all required packages (numpy, pandas, scikit-learn) properly installed. The issue is that VSCode is using the wrong Python interpreter (global Python at /usr/bin/python3 which doesn't have these packages). Fix IntelliSense by selecting the correct Python interpreter from the virtual environment. Use Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P), search for 'Python: Select Interpreter', and choose the interpreter at ./venv/bin/python or ~/workspace/ml_project/venv/bin/python. After selecting the interpreter, reload the VSCode window if necessary (Ctrl+Shift+P → 'Developer: Reload Window'). The task is complete when the correct venv interpreter is configured in workspace settings.
